findings.judgment: Strictly decreasing positive-payment present value justifies a unique root only within a certified sign-changing bracket. Fees change proceeds; simple proration changes the contract. A monetary enclosure crossing a rounding tie remains unresolved even when the output quantum is a cent.

Bayes normalization requires positive evidence probability. Semantic observation identity prevents duplicate likelihood use; representative counts cannot allocate refined mass. Exact lower-dimensional accounting equalities cannot be imposed by multiplying a Lebesgue density by a zero-volume indicator. The Gaussian example gives precision5/4, mean8/5, variance4/5 and cash mean116/variance80 under its explicit error model.

With U Bernoulli one-half, X=U,Y=2X+U, observing X1 gives Y3 while do(X1) gives Y2 or3 with mean2.5. The example illustrates distinct questions under supplied equations; filings and common random numbers do not identify actual causal effects.
